package settings

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestRenderContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("orders_keys", func(t *testing.T) {
		got, err := Render(map[string]string{"z": "last", "a": "first", "m": "middle"})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Render() error = %v", err)
		}
		want := []byte(`{"a":"first","m":"middle","z":"last"}`)
		if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("Render() = %q, want %q", got, want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("escapes_preserves_and_is_stable", func(t *testing.T) {
		input := map[string]string{
			"empty":   "",
			"hostile": "quote=\" slash=\\ newline=\n unicode=雪 <&>",
		}
		before := map[string]string{
			"empty":   "",
			"hostile": "quote=\" slash=\\ newline=\n unicode=雪 <&>",
		}

		first, err := Render(input)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("first Render() error = %v", err)
		}
		second, err := Render(input)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("second Render() error = %v", err)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(first, second) {
			t.Fatalf("repeated Render() outputs differ: %q and %q", first, second)
		}
		if bytes.HasSuffix(first, []byte("\n")) {
			t.Fatalf("Render() output has trailing newline: %q", first)
		}
		var decoded map[string]string
		if err := json.Unmarshal(first, &decoded); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Render() output is not one valid JSON object: %v; output %q", err, first)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(decoded, before) {
			t.Fatalf("decoded Render() output = %#v, want %#v", decoded, before)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(input, before) {
			t.Fatalf("Render() mutated input to %#v, want %#v", input, before)
		}
	})

	t.Run("nil_map_is_empty_object", func(t *testing.T) {
		got, err := Render(nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Render(nil) error = %v", err)
		}
		if string(got) != "{}" {
			t.Fatalf("Render(nil) = %q, want %q", got, "{}")
		}
	})
}
